column1: # Commit subject overrides for scripts/promote.sh (history workflow, docs/plans/workflow-history.md step H2).
# Tab-separated: <run sha prefix> <class: code|docs|bk|-> [subject]. "-" keeps the derived class; the subject
# replaces the derived first line of the promoted commit that this run commit heads (body and trailers stay).
# The sha is the commit on the run branch's first-parent line (the one "Needs a look" lists), never a
# feature-branch commit inside a merge: promote.sh refuses those. Rows for commits already on main, or for
# another run's commits, are skipped, so one file serves the main rewrite (E1) and the Phase 6 promotion (E2).
# Subjects follow `type(CODE): summary` (verifier.md); without an item code the scope is the area.
# From Phase 6 on the verifier writes semantic subjects itself, so new rows should rarely be needed.
# Every row was classifiable from its diff and merge message; none waits on the user (2026-11-05).
# Rewrite of main (Phases 0-5 and the earlier Phase 6 merges), from the 2026-11-02 dry run
